mapper.select: SELECT id FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId} AND community_id = #{communityId} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO events (community_id, title, description, start_at, end_at, application_deadline, location, capacity) VALUES (#{communityId}, #{input.title}, #{input.description}, #{input.startAt}, #{input.endAt}, #{input.applicationDeadline}, #{input.location}, #{input.capacity}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE events SET title = #{input.title}, description = #{input.description}, start_at = #{input.startAt}, end_at = #{input.endAt}, application_deadline = #{input.applicationDeadline}, location = #{input.location}, capacity = #{input.capacity} WHERE id = #{eventId}
